normative_extracts.quote: When set to true, indicates that the function specified by listener will never call preventDefault().

engine_internals.mechanism_summary: Non-passive wheel/touch listeners force the compositor thread to wait for main-thread JS to check preventDefault(); { passive: true } unlocks immediate compositor scrolling.

production_failures.symptom: Mobile scroll stutters by 100ms+ on touchstart even when listener only logs analytics
production_failures.root_cause: Attaching a touchstart/wheel listener on a non-root element without { passive: true } forces the compositor to block scrolling until JS finishes.
production_failures.mitigation: Pass { passive: true } to every wheel, touchstart, and touchmove listener that does not call preventDefault().

production_failures.symptom: Unable to preventDefault() inside document.addEventListener('wheel', fn)
production_failures.root_cause: Browsers default wheel and touchstart/touchmove listeners on window, document, and body to passive: true, ignoring preventDefault() with a console warning.
production_failures.mitigation: Explicitly pass { passive: false } only on the specific interactive canvas or element that must intercept scrolling.
